method: source audit of BASE..working tree, selected production Indirect branch; diagnostic feature inactive in ordinary builds
findings: Cull pipeline and bindings remain the same on I. One dispatch per placed mesh, ceil(meshlet_count/64) x 1 x 1; unchanged cull shader arguments and rejection code.

Forward retains pipeline, bindings, vertex/index buffers, placement order and multi_draw_indexed_indirect(draws, offset 0, meshlet_count). Sun caster index draws and diagnostic volume draw remain identical.

Indirect draw arguments remain STORAGE|INDIRECT|COPY_DST, meshlet bounds/ranges STORAGE|COPY_DST, cull uniforms UNIFORM|COPY_DST; visible count STORAGE|COPY_SRC|COPY_DST. Readback remains MAP_READ|COPY_DST. Vertex/index, material, instance, upload staging and volume usages are unchanged.

Per-frame cull writes remain 160 bytes at offset 0 per mesh. Conditional history writes remain four bytes at instance offset 64 when continued changes. History evaluation moved from encode_compute to encode_upload so Direct shares it; on I it derives the same continued/history_reset/material-promotion state. Writes are issued earlier in CPU recording, with the same values/count and before the next queue submission. Per-mesh interleaving of history and cull writes is reorganized; no added per-frame queue write on I.
Visible count readback copy and subsequent clear_buffer remain. Optional wrappers branch only on the selected path. Loader still stages the same meshlet metadata on I; Direct alone omits it.

Feature-observed command/resource records run only on resident swap; no probe draw executes with diagnostic_mode production. Paired cost arms explicitly select production, and baseline comparisons omit draw-probe entirely.
limits: This is a source/command audit, not a driver trace. Exact native and Chrome output/count comparisons and GPU suites independently test effects.
